question: Retrieve distinct case references, case numbers, investigation numbers, and clone information where a single clone simultaneously exhibits all three of the following genetic alterations: (1) a loss on chromosome 13 between positions 48,303,751 and 48,481,890, (2) a loss on chromosome 17 between positions 7,668,421 and 7,687,490, and (3) a gain on chromosome 11 between positions 108,223,067 and 108,369,102. For each matching clone, display the chromosomal details for each of these three regions (including chromosome number represented by ChrOrd, start position, and end position) and the corresponding karyotype short description from the KaryClone table. Use the CytoConverted and KaryClone.
sql:
WITH chr13_loss AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.RefNo, cc.CaseNo, cc.InvNo, cc.Clone
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc
  WHERE cc.Chr = 'chr13' 
    AND cc.Type = 'Loss'
    AND cc.End > 48303751
    AND cc.Start < 48481890
),
chr17_loss AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.RefNo, cc.CaseNo, cc.InvNo, cc.Clone
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc
  WHERE cc.Chr = 'chr17' 
    AND cc.Type = 'Loss'
    AND cc.End > 7668421
    AND cc.Start < 7687490
),
chr11_gain AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.RefNo, cc.CaseNo, cc.InvNo, cc.Clone
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc
  WHERE cc.Chr = 'chr11' 
    AND cc.Type = 'Gain'
    AND cc.End > 108223067
    AND cc.Start < 108369102
),
all_three AS (
  SELECT c13.RefNo, c13.CaseNo, c13.InvNo, c13.Clone
  FROM chr13_loss c13
  INNER JOIN chr17_loss c17 
    ON c13.RefNo = c17.RefNo 
    AND c13.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo 
    AND c13.InvNo = c17.InvNo 
    AND c13.Clone = c17.Clone
  INNER JOIN chr11_gain c11 
    ON c13.RefNo = c11.RefNo 
    AND c13.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo 
    AND c13.InvNo = c11.InvNo 
    AND c13.Clone = c11.Clone
),
chr13_details AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.RefNo, cc.CaseNo, cc.InvNo, cc.Clone, cc.ChrOrd, cc.Start, cc.End
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc
  WHERE cc.Chr = 'chr13' 
    AND cc.Type = 'Loss'
    AND cc.End > 48303751
    AND cc.Start < 48481890
),
chr17_details AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.RefNo, cc.CaseNo, cc.InvNo, cc.Clone, cc.ChrOrd, cc.Start, cc.End
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc
  WHERE cc.Chr = 'chr17' 
    AND cc.Type = 'Loss'
    AND cc.End > 7668421
    AND cc.Start < 7687490
),
chr11_details AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.RefNo, cc.CaseNo, cc.InvNo, cc.Clone, cc.ChrOrd, cc.Start, cc.End
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc
  WHERE cc.Chr = 'chr11' 
    AND cc.Type = 'Gain'
    AND cc.End > 108223067
    AND cc.Start < 108369102
),
combined AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    all_three.RefNo,
    all_three.CaseNo,
    all_three.InvNo,
    all_three.Clone,
    c13.ChrOrd AS Chr13_ChromOrd,
    c13.Start AS Chr13_Start,
    c13.End AS Chr13_End,
    c17.ChrOrd AS Chr17_ChromOrd,
    c17.Start AS Chr17_Start,
    c17.End AS Chr17_End,
    c11.ChrOrd AS Chr11_ChromOrd,
    c11.Start AS Chr11_Start,
    c11.End AS Chr11_End,
    kc.CloneShort
  FROM all_three
  JOIN chr13_details c13 ON all_three.RefNo = c13.RefNo AND all_three.CaseNo = c13.CaseNo AND all_three.InvNo = c13.InvNo AND all_three.Clone = c13.Clone
  JOIN chr17_details c17 ON all_three.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND all_three.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND all_three.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND all_three.Clone = c17.Clone
  JOIN chr11_details c11 ON all_three.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND all_three.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND all_three.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND all_three.Clone = c11.Clone
  JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` kc ON all_three.RefNo = kc.RefNo AND all_three.CaseNo = kc.CaseNo AND all_three.InvNo = kc.InvNo AND all_three.Clone = kc.CloneNo
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  RefNo,
  CaseNo,
  InvNo,
  Clone,
  Chr13_ChromOrd,
  Chr13_Start,
  Chr13_End,
  Chr17_ChromOrd,
  Chr17_Start,
  Chr17_End,
  Chr11_ChromOrd,
  Chr11_Start,
  Chr11_End,
  CloneShort
FROM combined
ORDER BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone
